tools.name: check_domain_prices
tools.description: Check one domain availability using registry RDAP and independent evidence, and compare standard registrar prices. Premium name quotes are not confused with standard TLD prices.

tools.name: compare_registrar_prices
tools.description: Rank registrar registration, renewal or transfer prices for one TLD, with sources, eligibility and three-year cost data.

tools.name: calculate_domain_cost
tools.description: Calculate 1, 3, 5 or 10-year domain ownership costs by registrar from first-year and current renewal prices.

tools.name: compare_transfer_savings
tools.description: Compare verifiable transfer-in costs and renewal savings over a chosen horizon, accounting for years included with each transfer.
